title: Members & roles
subtitle: Who holds which role on this project or its workstreams. Changes take effect immediately and are audited.

grant.title: Grant a role
grant.workstreamHint: Leave empty to grant the role on the whole project.
grant.validToHint: Optional end date; access stops automatically after this date.
grant.pick: Choose a person and a role to see the effect.
grant.effectProject: {user} receives the role “{role}” on the whole project.
grant.effectImmediate: The new access applies from the person's next request.
grant.serverDecides: The server checks whether you may grant this role and at this scope; refused requests are explained here.

revoke.title: Revoke role
revoke.effect: {user} loses the role “{role}” on this project immediately.
revoke.effectJobs: Queued background jobs acting for this person re-check access and stop if it was removed.
